sloka: सन्तुष्टस्तेन वाक्येन रावणस्तस्य सारथेः ।प्रशस्यैनं बहुविधं युद्धलुब्धो ऽब्रवीदिदम् ।। ६.१०६.२५ ।।
transliteration: santuṣṭastena vākyena rāvaṇastasya sāratheḥ ।praśasyainaṁ bahuvidhaṁ yuddhalubdho 'bravīdidam ।। 6.106.25 ।।

translations.english: "Quickly drive the chariot towards Raghava. As a policy, Ravana would never turn back on the battlefield without putting an end to the enemy."
